scope: Source-only release evidence for a conditional complete-form domain and zero-mode Schur development. This is an internal isolated compilation and integrity review, not external independent review, a new arithmetic estimate, all-radius positivity, or an RH proof.
distribution_boundary: Compiled objects and private compilation logs are not distributed. Their hashes identify the currently checked internal evidence only; readers reproduce verification from sources using the pinned dependencies.

verification_levels.local_sources: All listed modules have successful isolated Lean compilation evidence with standard terminal axiom lists.
verification_levels.incremental_reuse: Previous isolated objects reused only after matching recursive source/import fingerprints, current source and object hashes, the pinned toolchain/package paths, and all already-processed local dependency object hashes. Matching original isolated compile log/object provenance was separately checked.
verification_levels.kernel_recheck: This receipt records Lean source elaboration/compilation and #print axioms audits. It does not claim a separate independent kernel-recheck pass.
verification_levels.package_boundary: Existing pinned Lean toolchain and direct package import binaries were hashed, not rebuilt. Transitive package libraries remain explicit dependencies.

utility_excerpts.scope: Exact retained declaration texts and existing excerpt header preserved byte for byte from the prior accepted candidate; surrounding unused declarations of the original module are not included.
